# A squash on the lawn: a squat faceted gourd and a short stem. Up Z.
new
add mesh uv-sphere --name Gourd --segments 8 --rings 5 --radius 1 --location 0 0 0.2
scale 0.34 0.34 0.22
apply --scale
material new Gourd --base-color 0.467 0.455 0.310
material assign Gourd
add mesh cylinder --name Stem --vertices 5 --radius 0.045 --depth 0.14 --location 0 0 0.46
material new Stem --base-color 0.227 0.376 0.290
material assign Stem
select all
shade flat
export pumpkin.glb
